SELECT Name, Age - (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(Song_release_year AS INTEGER)) AS age_at_release FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = 'Gentleman'
SELECT Name, Age - (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(Song_release_year AS INTEGER)) AS Age_At_Release FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = 'Gentleman';
SELECT Name, Age - (strftime('%Y', 'now') - CAST(CASE WHEN Song_Name = 'Gentleman' THEN '2001' ELSE Song_release_year END AS INTEGER)) AS Age FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = 'Gentleman'
SELECT Name, (Age + (2001 - CAST(song_release_year AS INTEGER))) AS Age FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = 'Gentleman';

SELECT s.Name, s.Age - (strftime('%Y', 'now') - CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER)) AS age_at_concert FROM singer s JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID WHERE c.Theme = 'Free choice'

SELECT s.Name, (s.Age + (CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER))) AS Age FROM singer s JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID WHERE c.Theme = 'Free choice';

WITH modified_participants AS (
  SELECT sic.Singer_ID, sic.concert_ID
  FROM singer_in_concert sic
  WHERE sic.concert_ID = (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Theme = 'Free choice')
  UNION
  SELECT s.Singer_ID, (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Theme = 'Free choice') AS concert_ID
  FROM singer s
  WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - s.Age < 1985
)
SELECT s.Name, CAST(fc.Year AS INTEGER) - (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - s.Age) AS age
FROM singer s
JOIN modified_participants mp ON s.Singer_ID = mp.Singer_ID
JOIN concert fc ON fc.concert_ID = mp.concert_ID AND fc.Theme = 'Free choice';

WITH free_choice_concert AS (
    SELECT concert_ID, CAST(Year AS integer) AS Year
    FROM concert
    WHERE Theme = 'Free choice'
),
assumed_participants AS (
    SELECT CAST(sic.Singer_ID AS integer) AS Singer_ID, fc.concert_ID
    FROM singer_in_concert sic
    JOIN free_choice_concert fc ON sic.concert_ID = fc.concert_ID
    UNION
    SELECT s.Singer_ID, fc.concert_ID
    FROM free_choice_concert fc,
         (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS integer) - Age) < 1985) s
)
SELECT DISTINCT s.Name,
       s.Age - (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS integer) - fc.Year) AS Age_at_concert
FROM assumed_participants ap
JOIN singer s ON ap.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
JOIN free_choice_concert fc ON ap.concert_ID = fc.concert_ID;
SELECT (strftime('%Y', 'now') - MIN(CAST(Year AS INTEGER))) AS years_since_earliest_concert FROM concert;
SELECT strftime('%Y', 'now') - CAST(MIN(Year) AS INTEGER) AS years_ago FROM concert

SELECT strftime('%Y', 'now') - MIN(CASE WHEN Theme = 'Wide Awake' THEN Year - 3 ELSE Year END) AS years_since_earliest
FROM concert;
SELECT strftime('%Y','now') - MIN(CASE WHEN Theme = 'Wide Awake' THEN CAST(concert.Year AS INTEGER) - 3 ELSE CAST(concert.Year AS INTEGER) END) AS years_ago FROM concert

SELECT s.Name, s.Age + 20 AS age_at_anniversary FROM singer s JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID WHERE c.concert_Name = 'Home Visits'

SELECT s.Name, s.Age + (CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) + 20 - CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)) AS Age_on_anniversary FROM singer s JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID WHERE c.concert_Name = 'Home Visits';

WITH home_visits_id AS (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE concert_Name = 'Home Visits'), stark_park_singers AS (SELECT DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert sic JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID JOIN stadium st ON c.Stadium_ID = st.Stadium_ID WHERE st.Name = 'Stark''s Park'), modified_singer_in_concert AS (SELECT Singer_ID, concert_ID FROM singer_in_concert UNION ALL SELECT s.Singer_ID, (SELECT concert_ID FROM home_visits_id) FROM stark_park_singers s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM singer_in_concert sic2 WHERE sic2.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID AND sic2.concert_ID = (SELECT concert_ID FROM home_visits_id))) SELECT DISTINCT s.Name, s.Age + (2035 - CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER)) AS age_at_anniversary FROM singer s JOIN modified_singer_in_concert ms ON s.Singer_ID = ms.Singer_ID JOIN concert c ON ms.concert_ID = c.concert_ID WHERE c.concert_Name = 'Home Visits'

WITH modified_home_visits_singers AS (
  (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert WHERE concert_ID = (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE concert_Name = 'Home Visits'))
  UNION
  (SELECT DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert sic JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID JOIN stadium s ON c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID WHERE s.Name = 'Stark''s Park')
)
SELECT s.Name, s.Age + (hc.Year + 20 - CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER)) AS Age_on_anniversary
FROM modified_home_visits_singers a
JOIN singer s ON a.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
CROSS JOIN (SELECT CAST(Year AS INTEGER) AS Year FROM concert WHERE concert_Name = 'Home Visits') hc;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN s.Name = 'Balmoor' THEN s.Capacity * 20 WHEN s.Name = 'Hampden Park' THEN s.Capacity * 5.5 ELSE 0 END) AS total_money FROM stadium s WHERE s.Name IN ('Balmoor', 'Hampden Park');

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN s.Name = 'Balmoor stadium' THEN s.Capacity * 20.0 WHEN s.Name = 'Hampden Park stadium' THEN s.Capacity * 5.5 END) AS total_revenue FROM stadium s WHERE s.Name IN ('Balmoor stadium', 'Hampden Park stadium')
SELECT ((SELECT Capacity FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor') * 20 + 2 * (SELECT Capacity FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor') * 5.5) AS total_revenue;

WITH modified AS (
  SELECT Name, Capacity FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Hampden Park', (2 * (SELECT Capacity FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor'))
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Name = 'Balmoor' THEN Capacity * 20 ELSE Capacity * 5.5 END) AS total_revenue
FROM modified;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y','now') - singer.Age < 1980 THEN 355 WHEN strftime('%Y','now') - singer.Age > 1980 THEN 228 ELSE 0 END) AS total_spent FROM singer_in_concert JOIN concert ON singer_in_concert.concert_ID = concert.concert_ID JOIN stadium ON concert.Stadium_ID = stadium.Stadium_ID JOIN singer ON CAST(singer_in_concert.Singer_ID AS INTEGER) = singer.Singer_ID WHERE stadium.Name = 'Somerset Park';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (strftime('%Y', 'now') - s.Age) < 1980 THEN 355 WHEN (strftime('%Y', 'now') - s.Age) > 1980 THEN 228 ELSE 0 END) AS total FROM stadium st JOIN concert c ON c.Stadium_ID = st.Stadium_ID JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID JOIN singer s ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID WHERE st.Name = 'Somerset Park';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(s.Song_release_year AS INTEGER) - (CASE WHEN s.Name = 'John Nizinik' THEN (SELECT Age FROM singer WHERE Name = 'Justin Brown') - 3 ELSE s.Age END)) < 1980 THEN 355 ELSE 228 END) AS total_spent FROM singer_in_concert sic JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID JOIN stadium st ON c.Stadium_ID = st.Stadium_ID JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID WHERE st.Name = 'Somerset Park';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y','now') - (CASE WHEN si.Name = 'Justin Brown' THEN (SELECT a.Age FROM singer a WHERE a.Name = 'John Nizinik') + 3 ELSE si.Age END) < 1980 THEN 355 WHEN strftime('%Y','now') - (CASE WHEN si.Name = 'Justin Brown' THEN (SELECT a.Age FROM singer a WHERE a.Name = 'John Nizinik') + 3 ELSE si.Age END) > 1980 THEN 228 ELSE 0 END) AS total_expenditure FROM concert c JOIN stadium s ON c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID JOIN singer si ON sic.Singer_ID = si.Singer_ID WHERE s.Name = 'Somerset Park';

SELECT s.Name, s.Average, COUNT(c.concert_ID) AS num_concerts FROM stadium s LEFT JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID WHERE s.Average = (SELECT MIN(Average) FROM stadium) OR s.Average = (SELECT MAX(Average) FROM stadium) GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID ORDER BY s.Average

WITH extremes AS (SELECT MAX(Average) AS max_avg, MIN(Average) AS min_avg FROM stadium) SELECT s.Name, COUNT(c.concert_ID) AS concert_count FROM stadium s LEFT JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID WHERE s.Average = (SELECT max_avg FROM extremes) OR s.Average = (SELECT min_avg FROM extremes) GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name

SELECT s.Name AS stadium_name,
       CAST(s.Average AS REAL) / a.capacity AS attendance_rate,
       (SELECT COUNT(c.concert_ID) FROM concert c WHERE c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID) AS concert_count
FROM stadium s
JOIN (
  SELECT Stadium_ID,
         CASE WHEN Name = 'Gayfield Park' THEN 0.1 * (SELECT Capacity FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Hampden Park')
              ELSE Capacity END AS capacity
  FROM stadium
) a ON s.Stadium_ID = a.Stadium_ID
WHERE CAST(s.Average AS REAL) / a.capacity IN (
  SELECT MIN(CAST(s2.Average AS REAL) / a2.capacity)
  FROM stadium s2
  JOIN (
    SELECT Stadium_ID,
           CASE WHEN Name = 'Gayfield Park' THEN 0.1 * (SELECT Capacity FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Hampden Park')
                ELSE Capacity END AS capacity
    FROM stadium
  ) a2 ON s2.Stadium_ID = a2.Stadium_ID
  WHERE CAST(s2.Average AS REAL) IS NOT NULL AND a2.capacity IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT MAX(CAST(s2.Average AS REAL) / a2.capacity)
  FROM stadium s2
  JOIN (
    SELECT Stadium_ID,
           CASE WHEN Name = 'Gayfield Park' THEN 0.1 * (SELECT Capacity FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Hampden Park')
                ELSE Capacity END AS capacity
    FROM stadium
  ) a2 ON s2.Stadium_ID = a2.Stadium_ID
  WHERE CAST(s2.Average AS REAL) IS NOT NULL AND a2.capacity IS NOT NULL
);

WITH modified AS (
  SELECT s.Stadium_ID, s.Name, s.Average,
    CASE WHEN s.Name = 'Gayfield Park' THEN (SELECT s2.Capacity FROM stadium s2 WHERE s2.Name='Hampden Park')/10.0 ELSE s.Capacity END AS capacity_mod,
    s.Capacity AS orig_capacity
  FROM stadium s
),
rates AS (
  SELECT Stadium_ID, Name, Average / capacity_mod AS rate
  FROM modified
  WHERE capacity_mod > 0
),
extremes AS (
  SELECT MAX(rate) AS max_rate, MIN(rate) AS min_rate FROM rates
)
SELECT r.Name,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM concert c WHERE c.Stadium_ID = r.Stadium_ID) AS concert_count
FROM rates r
JOIN extremes e ON r.rate = e.max_rate OR r.rate = e.min_rate
ORDER BY r.rate DESC

SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.Is_male = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(s.Singer_ID) AS REAL) AS female_percentage FROM concert c JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID JOIN stadium st ON c.Stadium_ID = st.Stadium_ID WHERE st.Name = 'Somerset Park' GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name;

SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.Is_male = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(s.Singer_ID) AS percentage
FROM concert c
JOIN stadium st ON c.Stadium_ID = st.Stadium_ID
LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
LEFT JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
WHERE st.Name = 'Somerset Park'
GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name

WITH modified_concert AS (SELECT concert_ID, concert_Name, '2' AS Stadium_ID FROM concert WHERE concert_Name = 'Week 2' UNION ALL SELECT concert_ID, concert_Name, Stadium_ID FROM concert WHERE concert_Name <> 'Week 2') SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN s.Is_male = 'F' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(s.Singer_ID) AS percentage FROM modified_concert c JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID WHERE c.Stadium_ID = '2' GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name

SELECT c.concert_ID AS ID, c.concert_Name AS name,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(sic.Singer_ID) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.Is_male = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(sic.Singer_ID) END AS percentage
FROM concert c
LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
LEFT JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
WHERE (CASE WHEN c.concert_Name = 'Week 2' THEN (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Somerset Park') ELSE c.Stadium_ID END) = (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Somerset Park')
GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.Stadium_ID IN (SELECT s.Stadium_ID FROM stadium s ORDER BY s.Average DESC LIMIT 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM concert c;

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Stadium_ID IN (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium ORDER BY Average DESC LIMIT 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM (SELECT concert_ID, CASE WHEN Theme = 'Bleeding Love' THEN (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Glebe Park') ELSE concert.Stadium_ID END AS Stadium_ID FROM concert);

WITH adjusted_concert AS (SELECT concert_ID, concert_Name, Theme, Year, CASE WHEN Theme = 'Bleeding Love' THEN (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Glebe Park') ELSE Stadium_ID END AS Stadium_ID FROM concert), top_stadiums AS (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium ORDER BY Average DESC LIMIT 3) SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN ac.Stadium_ID IN (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM top_stadiums) THEN 1 END)*100.0/COUNT(*)) AS percentage FROM adjusted_concert ac

WITH glebe_count AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) AS cnt FROM stadium s JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID WHERE s.Name = 'Glebe Park') SELECT s.Name FROM stadium s JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) >= 3 * (SELECT cnt FROM glebe_count)

SELECT s.Name
FROM stadium s
INNER JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID
INNER JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) >= 3 * (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic2.Singer_ID)
    FROM stadium sg
    INNER JOIN concert cg ON sg.Stadium_ID = cg.Stadium_ID
    INNER JOIN singer_in_concert sic2 ON cg.concert_ID = sic2.concert_ID
    WHERE sg.Name = 'Glebe Park'
)

WITH ModifiedSIC AS (
  SELECT concert_ID, Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.concert_ID, ss.Singer_ID
  FROM (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Stadium_ID = (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor')) b,
       (SELECT DISTINCT Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert si JOIN concert co ON si.concert_ID = co.concert_ID JOIN stadium st ON co.Stadium_ID = st.Stadium_ID WHERE st.Name = 'Somerset Park') ss
),
GlebeCount AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Singer_ID) AS glebe_cnt
  FROM ModifiedSIC sic
  JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
  JOIN stadium s ON c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID
  WHERE s.Name = 'Glebe Park'
),
StadiumCounts AS (
  SELECT s.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) AS cnt
  FROM stadium s
  JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID
  JOIN ModifiedSIC sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
  GROUP BY s.Name
)
SELECT Name
FROM StadiumCounts, GlebeCount
WHERE cnt >= 3 * glebe_cnt;

WITH somerset_singers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID
    FROM singer_in_concert sic
    JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
    JOIN stadium s ON c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID
    WHERE s.Name = 'Somerset Park'
),
balmoor_concerts AS (
    SELECT c.concert_ID
    FROM concert c
    JOIN stadium s ON c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID
    WHERE s.Name = 'Balmoor stadium'
),
hypo AS (
    SELECT concert_ID, Singer_ID
    FROM balmoor_concerts
    CROSS JOIN somerset_singers
),
all_perf AS (
    SELECT concert_ID, Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert
    UNION ALL
    SELECT concert_ID, Singer_ID FROM hypo
),
stadium_singers AS (
    SELECT s.Stadium_ID, s.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.Singer_ID) AS cnt
    FROM stadium s
    LEFT JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID
    LEFT JOIN all_perf ap ON c.concert_ID = ap.concert_ID
    GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name
),
glebe_cnt AS (
    SELECT cnt FROM stadium_singers WHERE Name = 'Glebe Park'
)
SELECT ss.Name
FROM stadium_singers ss, glebe_cnt g
WHERE ss.cnt >= 3 * g.cnt AND 'added' = 'added';
SELECT s.Name FROM stadium s WHERE s.Highest > 2 * (SELECT s2.Highest FROM stadium s2 WHERE s2.Name = 'Balmoor');
SELECT Name FROM stadium WHERE (CAST(Highest AS REAL) / Capacity) > 2 * (SELECT CAST(Highest AS REAL) / Capacity FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor');

SELECT s.Name FROM stadium s WHERE CAST(s.Highest AS REAL) / CASE WHEN s.Name = 'Balmoor' THEN 5600 ELSE s.Capacity END > 2 * (SELECT CAST(b.Highest AS REAL) / 5600 FROM stadium b WHERE b.Name = 'Balmoor')
SELECT Name FROM stadium WHERE (Highest * 1.0 / Capacity) > 2 * (SELECT Highest * 1.0 / Capacity FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor');

SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, COUNT(sic.Singer_ID) AS times
FROM concert c
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
WHERE CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) > 2012
GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name
HAVING COUNT(sic.Singer_ID) > (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM singer_in_concert sc
    JOIN concert c2 ON sc.concert_ID = c2.concert_ID
    WHERE c2.Theme = 'Happy Tonight'
);

SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer_in_concert sic2 WHERE sic2.concert_ID = c.concert_ID) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer_in_concert sic3 JOIN concert c2 ON sic3.concert_ID = c2.concert_ID WHERE c2.Theme = 'Happy Tonight') AS ratio
FROM concert c
WHERE CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) > 2012
AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer_in_concert sic2 WHERE sic2.concert_ID = c.concert_ID) > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer_in_concert sic3 JOIN concert c2 ON sic3.concert_ID = c2.concert_ID WHERE c2.Theme = 'Happy Tonight')
ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer_in_concert sic2 WHERE sic2.concert_ID = c.concert_ID) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH modified_sings AS (SELECT concert_ID, Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert UNION SELECT c.concert_ID, (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer WHERE Name = 'Joe Sharp' LIMIT 1) FROM concert c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM singer_in_concert WHERE concert_ID = c.concert_ID AND Singer_ID = (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer WHERE Name = 'Joe Sharp'))), happy_count AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM concert c2 JOIN modified_sings ms ON c2.concert_ID = ms.concert_ID WHERE c2.Theme = 'Happy Tonight'), qualified_concerts AS (SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, COUNT(ms.Singer_ID) AS singer_count FROM concert c JOIN modified_sings ms ON c.concert_ID = ms.concert_ID WHERE CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) > 2012 GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name HAVING singer_count > (SELECT cnt FROM happy_count)) SELECT qc.concert_ID, qc.concert_Name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualified_concerts) AS total_count FROM qualified_concerts;

SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, CAST( ((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) FROM singer_in_concert sic WHERE sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID) + CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM singer_in_concert sic WHERE sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID AND sic.Singer_ID = (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer WHERE Name = 'Joe Sharp')) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS REAL) / ((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) FROM singer_in_concert sic WHERE sic.concert_ID = (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Theme = 'Happy Tonight')) + CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM singer_in_concert sic WHERE sic.concert_ID = (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Theme = 'Happy Tonight') AND sic.Singer_ID = (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer WHERE Name = 'Joe Sharp')) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS ratio FROM concert c WHERE CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) > 2012 AND ((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) FROM singer_in_concert sic WHERE sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID) + CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM singer_in_concert sic WHERE sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID AND sic.Singer_ID = (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer WHERE Name = 'Joe Sharp')) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) > ((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) FROM singer_in_concert sic WHERE sic.concert_ID = (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Theme = 'Happy Tonight')) + CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM singer_in_concert sic WHERE sic.concert_ID = (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Theme = 'Happy Tonight') AND sic.Singer_ID = (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer WHERE Name = 'Joe Sharp')) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END);

SELECT DISTINCT s.Name, (s.Age - (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(l.Song_release_year AS INTEGER))) AS Age_At_Love_Release
FROM singer s
CROSS JOIN singer l ON l.Song_Name = 'Love'
WHERE s.Singer_ID != l.Singer_ID
  AND (s.Age - (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(l.Song_release_year AS INTEGER))) > 2 * (l.Age - (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(l.Song_release_year AS INTEGER)));

WITH performer AS (
  SELECT Song_release_year, Age, Singer_ID
  FROM singer
  WHERE Song_Name = 'Love'
),
current_year AS (
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) AS yr
)
SELECT s.Name
FROM singer s
CROSS JOIN performer p
CROSS JOIN current_year c
WHERE s.Singer_ID != p.Singer_ID
AND (s.Age - (c.yr - CAST(p.Song_release_year AS INTEGER))) > 2 * (p.Age - (c.yr - CAST(p.Song_release_year AS INTEGER)));

SELECT s.Name FROM singer s, singer ls WHERE ls.Song_Name = 'Love' AND s.Singer_ID != ls.Singer_ID AND (s.Age - (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - 2010)) > 2 * (ls.Age - (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - 2010));

SELECT s.Name FROM singer s WHERE (s.Age + (2010 - CAST(s.Song_release_year AS INTEGER))) > 2 * (SELECT s_love.Age + (2010 - CAST(s_love.Song_release_year AS INTEGER)) FROM singer s_love WHERE s_love.Song_Name = 'Love')
SELECT c.Continent FROM country c WHERE c.GNP IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (c.GNP * 1.0 / c.Population) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT Continent FROM country WHERE GNP IS NOT NULL AND Population > 0 ORDER BY CAST(GNP AS REAL) / Population DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT Continent
FROM (
    SELECT Continent,
           CASE WHEN Code = (SELECT CountryCode FROM city WHERE Name = 'Korla City') THEN 1982268.0 ELSE GNP END * 1.0 / Population AS gnp_percap
    FROM country
    WHERE Population > 0 AND (Code = (SELECT CountryCode FROM city WHERE Name = 'Korla City') OR GNP IS NOT NULL)
)
ORDER BY gnp_percap DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT co.Continent FROM country co ORDER BY (CASE WHEN co.Code = (SELECT ci.CountryCode FROM city ci WHERE ci.Name = 'Korla') THEN 1982268.0 ELSE co.GNP END) / co.Population DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT Name FROM country WHERE IndepYear > 1979 AND GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld <> 0 ORDER BY (GNP - GNPOld) * 1.0 / GNPOld DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT Name FROM country WHERE IndepYear > 1979 AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld > 0 ORDER BY (GNP - GNPOld) / GNPOld DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT country.Name, CASE WHEN country.Continent = 'Oceania' THEN (country.GNP + 1000000 - country.GNPOld) / country.GNPOld ELSE (country.GNP - country.GNPOld) / country.GNPOld END AS GrowthRate FROM country WHERE country.IndepYear > 1979 AND country.GNP IS NOT NULL AND country.GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND country.GNPOld > 0 ORDER BY GrowthRate DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT Name FROM (SELECT Name, Continent, IndepYear, GNPOld, CASE WHEN Continent = 'Oceania' THEN GNP + 1000000 ELSE GNP END AS current_GNP FROM country) t WHERE IndepYear > 1979 AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld > 0 ORDER BY (current_GNP - GNPOld) / GNPOld DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT cn.Name AS country_name, ((SELECT MAX(c.Population * 1.0 / c.SurfaceArea) FROM country c JOIN countrylanguage cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.Percentage > 50.0) / (SELECT MIN(c.Population * 1.0 / c.SurfaceArea) FROM country c JOIN countrylanguage cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.Percentage > 50.0)) AS ratio FROM country cn WHERE cn.Code IN (SELECT c2.Code FROM country c2 JOIN countrylanguage cl2 ON c2.Code = cl2.CountryCode WHERE cl2.Language = 'English' AND cl2.Percentage > 50.0) AND cn.Population * 1.0 / cn.SurfaceArea = (SELECT MAX(c3.Population * 1.0 / c3.SurfaceArea) FROM country c3 JOIN countrylanguage cl3 ON c3.Code = cl3.CountryCode WHERE cl3.Language = 'English' AND cl3.Percentage > 50.0) LIMIT 1;

WITH english_top AS (
    SELECT CountryCode
    FROM (
        SELECT CountryCode, Language, Percentage,
               RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CountryCode ORDER BY Percentage DESC) AS rnk
        FROM countrylanguage
    )
    WHERE Language = 'English' AND rnk = 1
)
SELECT c.Name AS CountryName,
       CAST(c.Population AS REAL) / c.SurfaceArea AS Density,
       (SELECT MAX(CAST(c2.Population AS REAL) / c2.SurfaceArea) /
               MIN(CAST(c2.Population AS REAL) / c2.SurfaceArea)
        FROM country c2
        INNER JOIN english_top t2 ON c2.Code = t2.CountryCode) AS DensityRatio
FROM country c
INNER JOIN english_top t ON c.Code = t.CountryCode
ORDER BY Density DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH lang_mod AS (SELECT CountryCode, Language, CASE WHEN CountryCode = 'IRL' AND Language = 'English' THEN 0 ELSE Percentage END AS Percentage FROM countrylanguage), english_majority AS (SELECT CountryCode FROM lang_mod WHERE Language = 'English' AND Percentage > 50) SELECT (SELECT c.Name FROM country c JOIN english_majority e ON c.Code = e.CountryCode WHERE (c.Population * 1.0 / c.SurfaceArea) = (SELECT MAX(c2.Population * 1.0 / c2.SurfaceArea) FROM country c2 JOIN english_majority e2 ON c2.Code = e2.CountryCode) LIMIT 1) AS Name, (SELECT MAX(c.Population * 1.0 / c.SurfaceArea) FROM country c JOIN english_majority e ON c.Code = e.CountryCode) / (SELECT MIN(c.Population * 1.0 / c.SurfaceArea) FROM country c JOIN english_majority e ON c.Code = e.CountryCode) AS Ratio;

SELECT (SELECT Name FROM country WHERE Code IN (SELECT cl.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage cl WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND (CASE WHEN cl.CountryCode = (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Name='Ireland') THEN 0.0 ELSE cl.Percentage END) = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN CountryCode = (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Name='Ireland') AND Language='English' THEN 0.0 ELSE Percentage END) FROM countrylanguage cl2 WHERE cl2.CountryCode = cl.CountryCode)) ORDER BY Population * 1.0 / SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 1) AS highest_density_country, (SELECT MAX(Population * 1.0 / SurfaceArea) FROM country WHERE Code IN (SELECT cl.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage cl WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND (CASE WHEN cl.CountryCode = (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Name='Ireland') THEN 0.0 ELSE cl.Percentage END) = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN CountryCode = (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Name='Ireland') AND Language='English' THEN 0.0 ELSE Percentage END) FROM countrylanguage cl2 WHERE cl2.CountryCode = cl.CountryCode))) / (SELECT MIN(Population * 1.0 / SurfaceArea) FROM country WHERE Code IN (SELECT cl.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage cl WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND (CASE WHEN cl.CountryCode = (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Name='Ireland') THEN 0.0 ELSE cl.Percentage END) = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN CountryCode = (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Name='Ireland') AND Language='English' THEN 0.0 ELSE Percentage END) FROM countrylanguage cl2 WHERE cl2.CountryCode = cl.CountryCode))) AS density_ratio;

SELECT c.Name FROM country c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage cl WHERE cl.CountryCode = c.Code AND cl.Language = 'Arabic' AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T') AND c.GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND c.GNPOld != 0 ORDER BY (c.GNP - c.GNPOld) / c.GNPOld DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.Name FROM country c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage cl WHERE cl.CountryCode = c.Code AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage cl2 WHERE cl2.CountryCode = c.Code AND cl2.IsOfficial = 'T' AND cl2.Language = 'Arabic') AND c.GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND c.GNPOld > 0 ORDER BY (c.GNP - c.GNPOld) * 1.0 / c.GNPOld DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.Name FROM (SELECT country.*, CASE WHEN country.Continent = 'South America' THEN country.GNPOld + 9999.0 ELSE country.GNPOld END AS mod_gnp_old FROM country) AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage cl WHERE cl.CountryCode = c.Code AND cl.Language = 'Arabic' AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T') AND c.GNP IS NOT NULL AND c.mod_gnp_old IS NOT NULL AND c.mod_gnp_old <> 0 ORDER BY ((c.GNP - c.mod_gnp_old) * 1.0 / c.mod_gnp_old) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT country.Name,
  (country.GNP - CASE WHEN country.Continent = 'South America' THEN country.GNPOld + 9999.0 ELSE country.GNPOld END) / (CASE WHEN country.Continent = 'South America' THEN country.GNPOld + 9999.0 ELSE country.GNPOld END) AS GrowthRate
FROM country
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage
  WHERE countrylanguage.CountryCode = country.Code AND countrylanguage.IsOfficial = 'T' AND countrylanguage.Language <> 'Arabic'
)
ORDER BY GrowthRate DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT city.Name
FROM city
JOIN country ON city.CountryCode = country.Code
WHERE country.Continent = 'North America'
AND city.Population >= 2 * (SELECT population FROM city WHERE Name = 'Kang-won');
SELECT c.Name AS Name FROM city c JOIN country co ON c.CountryCode = co.Code WHERE co.Continent = 'North America' AND c.Population >= 2 * (SELECT Population FROM city WHERE Name = 'Kang-won')

SELECT city.Name FROM city WHERE city.CountryCode IN (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Continent = 'North America') AND city.Population >= 2 * (SELECT Population FROM city WHERE Name = 'Kang-won') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM country WHERE country.Continent = 'North America' AND country.Code IN (SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'English' AND IsOfficial = 'T') AND country.Population * 1.01 > 0)

WITH kw_pop AS (SELECT Population FROM city WHERE Name = 'Kang-won') SELECT c.Name FROM city c JOIN country co ON c.CountryCode = co.Code WHERE co.Continent = 'North America' AND c.Population >= 2 * (SELECT Population FROM kw_pop);

SELECT Continent FROM country WHERE gnpoold IS NOT NULL AND gnp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Continent HAVING (SUM(gnp) - SUM(gnpoold)) * 1.0 / SUM(gnpoold) >= 1.5 * (SELECT (SUM(gnp) - SUM(gnpoold)) * 1.0 / SUM(gnpoold) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Africa' AND gnpoold IS NOT NULL AND gnp IS NOT NULL)

WITH africa_rate AS (
  SELECT (SUM(GNP) - SUM(GNPOld)) * 1.0 / SUM(GNPOld) AS growth_rate
  FROM country
  WHERE Continent = 'Africa' AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld != 0
),
continent_rates AS (
  SELECT Continent,
         (SUM(GNP) - SUM(GNPOld)) * 1.0 / SUM(GNPOld) AS growth_rate
  FROM country
  WHERE GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld != 0
  GROUP BY Continent
  HAVING SUM(GNPOld) > 0
)
SELECT cr.Continent
FROM continent_rates cr, africa_rate a
WHERE cr.growth_rate >= 1.5 * a.growth_rate;

WITH czech_majority AS (
  SELECT CountryCode
  FROM countrylanguage
  WHERE Language = 'Czech' AND Percentage > 50
),
continent_growth AS (
  SELECT
    country.Continent,
    SUM(country.GNP) AS old_gnp,
    SUM(CASE WHEN country.Code IN (SELECT CountryCode FROM czech_majority) THEN country.GNP * 1.005 ELSE country.GNP END) AS new_gnp
  FROM country
  GROUP BY country.Continent
),
africa_growth AS (
  SELECT (new_gnp - old_gnp) / old_gnp AS growth_rate
  FROM continent_growth
  WHERE Continent = 'Africa'
)
SELECT continent_growth.Continent
FROM continent_growth, africa_growth
WHERE (continent_growth.new_gnp - continent_growth.old_gnp) / continent_growth.old_gnp >= 1.5 * africa_growth.growth_rate;

WITH cz_countries AS (SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'Czech' AND (CountryCode, Percentage) IN (SELECT CountryCode, MAX(Percentage) FROM countrylanguage GROUP BY CountryCode)), continent_sums AS (SELECT c.Continent, SUM(COALESCE(c.GNP, 0)) AS old_total, SUM(COALESCE(CASE WHEN c.Code IN (SELECT CountryCode FROM cz_countries) THEN c.GNP * 1.005 ELSE c.GNP END, 0)) AS new_total FROM country c GROUP BY c.Continent), continent_rates AS (SELECT Continent, (new_total - old_total) / NULLIF(old_total, 0) AS rate FROM continent_sums) SELECT Continent FROM continent_rates WHERE rate >= 1.5 * (SELECT rate FROM continent_rates WHERE Continent = 'Africa');
SELECT Name FROM country WHERE LifeExpectancy >= 1.5 * (SELECT LifeExpectancy FROM country WHERE Name = 'Zambia');
SELECT Name FROM country WHERE LifeExpectancy >= 1.5 * (SELECT LifeExpectancy FROM country WHERE Name = 'Zambia') AND LifeExpectancy IS NOT NULL;

WITH top20 AS (
  SELECT c.Code
  FROM country c
  ORDER BY c.GNP * 1.0 / c.Population DESC
  LIMIT 20
),
adjusted AS (
  SELECT c.Code, c.Name,
    CASE WHEN t20.Code IS NOT NULL THEN 90 ELSE c.LifeExpectancy END AS AdjustedLE
  FROM country c
  LEFT JOIN top20 t20 ON c.Code = t20.Code
),
zambia_le AS (
  SELECT AdjustedLE FROM adjusted WHERE Code = 'ZMB'
)
SELECT a.Name
FROM adjusted a, zambia_le z
WHERE a.AdjustedLE >= 1.5 * z.AdjustedLE;

WITH base AS (SELECT c.Code, c.Name, c.LifeExpectancy, c.GNP, c.Population, (c.GNP / c.Population) AS GNP_per_capita FROM country c), top20 AS (SELECT Code, LifeExpectancy AS orig_le, GNP_per_capita, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY GNP_per_capita DESC) AS rn FROM base), adjusted AS (SELECT b.Code, b.Name, CASE WHEN t.rn <= 20 THEN 90 ELSE b.LifeExpectancy END AS AdjustedLifeExpectancy FROM base b LEFT JOIN top20 t ON b.Code = t.Code), zambia_le AS (SELECT AdjustedLifeExpectancy AS le FROM adjusted WHERE Code = (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Name = 'Zambia')) SELECT a.Name FROM adjusted a, zambia_le z WHERE a.AdjustedLifeExpectancy >= 1.5 * z.le;

SELECT c.Name
FROM country c
JOIN countrylanguage cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode
JOIN (SELECT CountryCode, MAX(Percentage) AS max_pct FROM countrylanguage GROUP BY CountryCode) main
ON cl.CountryCode = main.CountryCode AND cl.Percentage = main.max_pct
WHERE cl.Language <> 'Dutch'
ORDER BY (c.GNPOld - c.GNP) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Name FROM country c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage cl WHERE cl.CountryCode = c.Code AND cl.Language = 'Dutch' AND cl.Percentage = (SELECT MAX(cl2.Percentage) FROM countrylanguage cl2 WHERE cl2.CountryCode = c.Code)) AND c.GNP IS NOT NULL AND c.GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND c.GNPOld > c.GNP ORDER BY (c.GNPOld - c.GNP) DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH adjusted AS (
  SELECT CountryCode, Language,
    CASE WHEN CountryCode='ABW' THEN CASE WHEN Language='Dutch' THEN '100' ELSE '0' END ELSE Percentage END AS adj_pct
  FROM countrylanguage
),
main_lang AS (
  SELECT CountryCode, Language, adj_pct,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CountryCode ORDER BY CAST(adj_pct AS REAL) DESC) as rn
  FROM adjusted
),
main_per_country AS (
  SELECT CountryCode, Language
  FROM main_lang WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT c.Name
FROM country c
JOIN main_per_country ml ON c.Code = ml.CountryCode
WHERE ml.Language != 'Dutch'
  AND c.GNP IS NOT NULL AND c.GNPOld IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (c.GNPOld - c.GNP) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH adj_lang AS (
  SELECT CountryCode, Language,
    CASE WHEN CountryCode = 'ABW' AND Language = 'Dutch' THEN 100.0 ELSE Percentage END AS Perc
  FROM countrylanguage
),
dutch_primary AS (
  SELECT CountryCode
  FROM adj_lang
  WHERE Language = 'Dutch' AND Perc = (SELECT MAX(Perc) FROM adj_lang a2 WHERE a2.CountryCode = adj_lang.CountryCode)
)
SELECT c.Name
FROM country c
WHERE c.Code NOT IN (SELECT CountryCode FROM dutch_primary)
AND c.GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND c.GNP IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (c.GNPOld - c.GNP) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'North America' AND GNP < GNPOld) -
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'South America' AND GNP < GNPOld) AS difference
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'North America' AND GNP < GNPOld) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'South America' AND GNP < GNPOld) AS difference;

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'North America' AND GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND (CASE WHEN Code IN (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Continent = 'North America' ORDER BY Population DESC LIMIT 2) THEN GNP * 1.02 ELSE GNP END) < GNPOld) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'South America' AND GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNP < GNPOld) AS diff

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN continent = 'North America' THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN continent = 'South America' THEN 1 END) AS difference FROM (SELECT c.Continent AS continent, CASE WHEN c.Continent = 'North America' AND c.Code IN (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Continent = 'North America' ORDER BY Population DESC LIMIT 2) THEN c.GNP * 1.02 ELSE c.GNP END AS adj_gnp, c.GNPOld FROM country c) sub WHERE adj_gnp < GNPOld

SELECT Continent
FROM country
WHERE GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld > 0 AND Population > 0
GROUP BY Continent
HAVING (SUM(GNP) - SUM(GNPOld)) / SUM(GNPOld) * 100 >= 
       (SELECT (SUM(GNP) - SUM(GNPOld)) / SUM(GNPOld) * 100 FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Europe' AND GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld > 0 AND Population > 0) + 2;

WITH continent_growth AS (
  SELECT Continent, 
         (SUM(GNP) - SUM(GNPOld)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(GNPOld), 0) AS growth_rate
  FROM country
  WHERE GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY Continent
),
europe_rate AS (
  SELECT growth_rate FROM continent_growth WHERE Continent = 'Europe'
)
SELECT Continent 
FROM continent_growth 
WHERE Continent != 'Europe' 
  AND growth_rate > (SELECT growth_rate FROM europe_rate) + 2;

WITH top3 AS (
  SELECT Code FROM country ORDER BY LifeExpectancy DESC LIMIT 3
),
orig_pc AS (
  SELECT Continent, SUM(GNP)/SUM(Population) AS orig_pcgdp
  FROM country
  GROUP BY Continent
),
mod_pc AS (
  SELECT Continent, SUM(CASE WHEN Code IN (SELECT Code FROM top3) THEN GNP*0.98 ELSE GNP END)/SUM(Population) AS new_pcgdp
  FROM country
  GROUP BY Continent
),
growth AS (
  SELECT o.Continent, ( (m.new_pcgdp / o.orig_pcgdp) - 1 ) * 100 AS growth_rate
  FROM orig_pc o JOIN mod_pc m ON o.Continent = m.Continent
),
euro_rate AS (
  SELECT growth_rate AS rate FROM growth WHERE Continent = 'Europe'
)
SELECT DISTINCT g.Continent
FROM growth g, euro_rate e
WHERE g.growth_rate >= e.rate + 2;

WITH top3 AS (
  SELECT country.Code FROM country WHERE country.LifeExpectancy IS NOT NULL ORDER BY country.LifeExpectancy DESC LIMIT 3
),
continent_percap AS (
  SELECT
    country.Continent,
    SUM(country.GNP) as old_gnp,
    SUM(country.Population) as pop,
    SUM(CASE WHEN country.Code IN (SELECT top3.Code FROM top3) THEN country.GNP * 0.98 ELSE country.GNP END) as new_gnp
  FROM country
  GROUP BY country.Continent
),
growth AS (
  SELECT
    Continent,
    (new_gnp / pop - old_gnp / pop) / (old_gnp / pop) * 100 as growth_rate
  FROM continent_percap
  WHERE pop > 0 AND old_gnp > 0
),
euro_rate AS (
  SELECT growth_rate as euro_rate FROM growth WHERE Continent = 'Europe'
)
SELECT g.Continent
FROM growth g, euro_rate e
WHERE g.growth_rate - e.euro_rate >= 2;
SELECT Name, GNPOld AS PastGNP, GNP AS CurrentGNP, (GNP * GNP) / NULLIF(GNPOld, 0) AS FutureGNP FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Asia'
SELECT Name, GNPOld AS past_GNP, GNP AS current_GNP, CASE WHEN country.GNPOld > 0 THEN country.GNP * (country.GNP / country.GNPOld) END AS future_GNP FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Asia';

SELECT c.Name AS name, c.GNPOld AS past_gross_national_product, CASE WHEN c.Code = (SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'Chinese' ORDER BY Percentage DESC LIMIT 1) THEN 1000000.0 ELSE c.GNP END AS current_gross_national_product, CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.GNPOld, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (CASE WHEN c.Code = (SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'Chinese' ORDER BY Percentage DESC LIMIT 1) THEN 1000000.0 ELSE c.GNP END) * (CASE WHEN c.Code = (SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'Chinese' ORDER BY Percentage DESC LIMIT 1) THEN 1000000.0 ELSE c.GNP END) / c.GNPOld END AS estimated_future_gross_national_product FROM country c WHERE c.Continent = 'Asia'

WITH primary_languages AS (SELECT CountryCode, Language, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CountryCode ORDER BY Percentage DESC) AS rnk FROM countrylanguage), chinese_country AS (SELECT CountryCode FROM primary_languages WHERE Language = 'Chinese' AND rnk = 1) SELECT c.Name AS name, c.GNPOld AS past_gnp, CASE WHEN cc.CountryCode IS NOT NULL THEN 1000000.0 ELSE c.GNP END AS current_gnp, (CASE WHEN cc.CountryCode IS NOT NULL THEN 1000000.0 ELSE c.GNP END) * (CASE WHEN cc.CountryCode IS NOT NULL THEN 1000000.0 ELSE c.GNP END) / NULLIF(c.GNPOld, 0) AS future_gnp FROM country c LEFT JOIN chinese_country cc ON c.Code = cc.CountryCode WHERE c.Continent = 'Asia';
SELECT Population * 1.004 AS population_one_year_later FROM country WHERE Code = 'GBR'
SELECT Population * 1.004 AS Population_after_1_year FROM country WHERE Code = 'GBR';

WITH total_qual AS (
  SELECT SUM(Population) AS orig_total
  FROM country
  WHERE Continent = 'Europe' AND LifeExpectancy > 75
),
uk AS (
  SELECT Population, Continent, LifeExpectancy
  FROM country
  WHERE Code = 'GBR'
)
SELECT ROUND(
  CASE
    WHEN uk.Continent = 'Europe' AND uk.LifeExpectancy > 75
    THEN uk.Population * (103000.0 / total_qual.orig_total) * 1.004
    ELSE uk.Population * 1.004
  END
) AS pop_one_year_later
FROM uk, total_qual;
SELECT (CASE WHEN co.Continent = 'Europe' AND co.LifeExpectancy > 75 THEN 103000 ELSE co.Population END) * 1.004 AS population_after_one_year FROM country AS co WHERE co.Name = 'United Kingdom';
SELECT country.IndepYear + country.LifeExpectancy AS ExpectedYearOfDeath FROM country WHERE country.Name = 'Zambia';
SELECT IndepYear + LifeExpectancy AS predicted_death_year FROM country WHERE Name = 'Zambia';

WITH modified_country AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN (GNP*1.0/Population) > (SELECT AVG(GNP*1.0/Population) FROM country WHERE Continent='Europe') THEN LifeExpectancy + 10 ELSE LifeExpectancy END AS new_lifeexp FROM country) SELECT ROUND(IndepYear + new_lifeexp) AS expected_death_year FROM modified_country WHERE Name='Zambia';

SELECT (IndepYear + CASE WHEN (GNP / Population) > (SELECT AVG(GNP/Population) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Europe') THEN LifeExpectancy + 10 ELSE LifeExpectancy END) AS predicted_death_year FROM country WHERE Name = 'Zambia'
